changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE processed_events ( consumer_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, user_id UUID NOT NULL, meal_id UUID NOT NULL, calories INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (calories >= 0), consumed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (consumer_name, user_id, meal_id) ); CREATE INDEX idx_processed_calories_period ON processed_events (user_id, consumed_at); CREATE TABLE outbox_messages ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, aggregate_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, aggregate_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, partition_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, topic VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, payload BYTEA NOT NULL, traceparent VARCHAR(256), status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'PUBLISHED', 'FAILED')), attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, published_at TIMESTAMPTZ, sequence_number BIGSERIAL NOT NULL UNIQUE, next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error VARCHAR(256), UNIQUE (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, topic) ); CREATE INDEX idx_profile_outbox_due ON outbox_messages (status, next_attempt_at, sequence_number); CREATE INDEX idx_profile_outbox_unpublished ON outbox_messages (topic, partition_key, sequence_number) WHERE status <> 'PUBLISHED';
